name: yivpn-agent-cli
description: Dual-mode VPN CLI & MCP server for AI agents with smart split-tunneling and free 90m/1GiB trial.
long_description: Official zero-dependency Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and CLI for YiVPN. Bridges to the local YiVPN desktop client MCP for safe sing-box split-tunneling hot-reload and rollback, or automatically runs a rootless cloud VPN proxy (127.0.0.1:10808) with a zero-account 90-minute / 1 GiB free trial via ed25519-v1 API and x402 Base USDC.
